how: Every high finding on the tuning half was read by hand in its commit. The first pass of the rules flagged 41 tuning commits; reading them found five patterns of false alarm (a bare fit() call read as Jasmine's focus marker, equal(x, true) to ok(x) read as loosening, prose in a baseline file, capture-then-check after || true, and a test loop replacing three explicit gate lines). The rules were fixed for those before the held-out half was opened. These labels cover what the final rules still flag.

items.label: cannot read
items.why: The test file holds NUL bytes on purpose (it tests a scrubber), so git stores it as binary and its lines cannot be read. Flagged instead of passed.
